problem.title: 找出所有重复的编号
problem.description:
仓库给 n 件货物贴编号，编号只会是 0 到 n-1 之间的整数。录入时出了差错，有的编号被贴在了不止一件货物上（至少有一个这样的编号）。请找出所有被重复使用的编号。

出处：《剑指 Offer（第 2 版）》剑指 Offer 03。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行一个整数 n（2 ≤ n ≤ 100000）。
第二行 n 个整数，依次是每件货物的编号，每个编号都在 0 到 n-1 之间。保证至少有一个编号出现了两次或更多。
problem.output: 一行，按从小到大的顺序输出所有出现次数不少于 2 的编号，以空格分隔，每个编号只输出一次。
problem.explanation:
样例 1 中，编号 1 出现了 2 次，编号 4 出现了 3 次，其余编号各出现一次，所以输出 1 4。
样例 2 只有两件货物，编号都是 1。
hints: 编号范围恰好是 0 到 n-1，一个长度为 n 的计数数组就能代替哈希表。
想做到额外空间 O(1)：把每个数交换到和它相等的下标上，交换时发现目标位置已经放着同样的数，它就是重复的。

en.title: Find Every Reused Label
en.description:
A warehouse labels n parcels with integers from 0 to n-1. A data-entry slip put some labels on more than one parcel (at least one label is reused). Find every label that was used more than once.

Source: Coding Interviews (剑指 Offer, 2nd ed.), Offer 03. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds an integer n (2 ≤ n ≤ 100000).
The second line holds n integers, the label of each parcel, each between 0 and n-1. At least one label appears two or more times.
en.output: One line: every label that appears at least twice, in increasing order, separated by spaces, each label printed once.
en.explanation:
In sample 1, label 1 appears twice and label 4 three times; every other label appears once, so the answer is 1 4.
Sample 2 has two parcels, both labelled 1.
hints: Labels lie exactly in 0..n-1, so a counting array of length n can replace a hash table.
For O(1) extra space, swap each value to the index equal to it; if that slot already holds the same value, the value is a repeat.

problem.title: 把空格编码成 %20
problem.description:
在网址里，空格不能直接出现，要写成 %20。给你一行文字，请把其中的每一个空格都替换成 %20，其余字符保持不变。

出处：《剑指 Offer（第 2 版）》剑指 Offer 05。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input: 一行字符串，长度在 1 到 10000 之间，由大小写字母、数字、标点和空格组成。开头、结尾都可能有空格，也可能有连续的空格。
problem.explanation:
样例 1 中有两个空格，各自变成 %20。
样例 2 的开头有一个空格、中间有两个相邻的空格，每个空格都要单独替换，所以出现了 %20%20。
hints: 先数出空格个数，就能算出结果的长度；从后往前填写，每个字符只需移动一次。
不要先去掉首尾空格，也不要把连续空格合并成一个。

en.title: Encode Spaces as %20
en.description:
A URL cannot hold a raw space; it is written as %20. Given one line of text, replace every space with %20 and leave every other character as it is.

Source: Coding Interviews (剑指 Offer, 2nd ed.), Offer 05. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input: One line of length 1 to 10000 made of letters, digits, punctuation and spaces. It may start or end with spaces and may contain runs of spaces.
en.output: One line: the text after the replacement.
en.explanation:
Sample 1 has two spaces, each becoming %20.
Sample 2 starts with a space and has two spaces in a row; each one is replaced separately, which gives %20%20.
hints: Count the spaces first to know the final length, then fill the result from the back so each character moves once.
Do not trim the ends and do not merge runs of spaces.

problem.title: 倒着读出一条链表
problem.description:
内存里有一条单向链表，共 n 个结点，结点编号为 0 到 n-1。每个结点存了一个整数值和下一个结点的编号，最后一个结点的“下一个”是 -1。结点的描述是乱序给出的，你只知道头结点的编号。
请从尾结点开始，一直到头结点，依次输出每个结点的值。

出处：《剑指 Offer（第 2 版）》剑指 Offer 06。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行两个整数 n 和 h（1 ≤ n ≤ 100000，0 ≤ h < n），表示结点数和头结点的编号。
接下来 n 行，第 i 行（i 从 0 开始）两个整数 v 和 nx，表示 i 号结点的值为 v（-10^9 ≤ v ≤ 10^9），下一个结点的编号为 nx（nx 为 -1 表示没有下一个结点）。
保证从头结点出发沿着 nx 走，恰好经过所有 n 个结点各一次。
problem.output: 一行 n 个整数，从尾结点到头结点依次输出结点的值，以空格分隔。
problem.explanation:
样例 1 的链表是 2 号 → 0 号 → 3 号 → 1 号，值依次为 7、5、-2、9，倒过来就是 9 -2 5 7。
样例 2 只有一个结点。
hints: 沿着 nx 走一遍记下顺序，再倒序输出；也可以用栈，或者用递归在“回来”的时候输出。
链表很长时，递归可能栈溢出，迭代写法更稳妥。

en.title: Read a Linked List Backwards
en.description:
A singly linked list in memory has n nodes numbered 0 to n-1. Each node stores an integer value and the number of the next node; the last node's next is -1. The nodes are described in no particular order, and you only know which node is the head.
Print the values from the tail node back to the head node.

Source: Coding Interviews (剑指 Offer, 2nd ed.), Offer 06. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds two integers n and h (1 ≤ n ≤ 100000, 0 ≤ h < n): the node count and the head's number.
Each of the next n lines (the i-th, counting from 0) holds two integers v and nx: node i has value v (-10^9 ≤ v ≤ 10^9) and its next node is nx (-1 means none).
Following nx from the head visits all n nodes, each exactly once.
en.output: One line with n integers: the values from the tail to the head, separated by spaces.
en.explanation:
In sample 1 the list is node 2 → node 0 → node 3 → node 1 with values 7, 5, -2, 9; backwards that is 9 -2 5 7.
Sample 2 has a single node.
hints: Walk the list once recording the order, then print it reversed; a stack works too, or recursion that prints on the way back.
On a long list recursion can overflow the call stack; the iterative version is safer.

problem.title: 用两个栈拼出一个队列
problem.description:
你手里只有“栈”这种数据结构：只能在一端压入和弹出。请用两个栈模拟一个先进先出的队列，支持两种操作：
push x：把整数 x 放到队尾；
pop：取出并输出队首元素；如果队列为空，输出 -1。
依次执行给定的操作。

出处：《剑指 Offer（第 2 版）》剑指 Offer 09。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行一个整数 q（1 ≤ q ≤ 100000），表示操作个数。
接下来 q 行，每行是 push x（-10^9 ≤ x ≤ 10^9）或 pop。
problem.output: 对每个 pop 操作输出一行，为取出的值，或者 -1。
problem.explanation: 样例 1 先放入 1、2，取出 1；再放入 3，依次取出 2 和 3；最后队列已空，输出 -1。
hints: 一个栈只管入队，另一个栈只管出队。出队栈空了，再把入队栈里的元素全部倒过去，顺序就反过来了。
每个元素最多被倒一次，所以总时间是 O(q)。

en.title: A Queue Out of Two Stacks
en.description:
All you have are stacks: push and pop at one end only. Use two stacks to act as a first-in, first-out queue that supports:
push x: put the integer x at the back;
pop: remove and print the front element, or print -1 if the queue is empty.
Run the given operations in order.

Source: Coding Interviews (剑指 Offer, 2nd ed.), Offer 09. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds an integer q (1 ≤ q ≤ 100000), the number of operations.
Each of the next q lines is push x (-10^9 ≤ x ≤ 10^9) or pop.
en.output: For each pop, print one line: the removed value or -1.
en.explanation: Sample 1 pushes 1 and 2 and pops 1; then it pushes 3 and pops 2 and 3; the queue is now empty, so the last pop prints -1.
hints: One stack takes the pushes, the other serves the pops. When the serving stack is empty, pour the whole first stack into it, which reverses the order.
Each element is poured at most once, so the total time is O(q).

problem.title: 斐波那契数取模
problem.description:
斐波那契数列定义为 F(0) = 0，F(1) = 1，当 n ≥ 2 时 F(n) = F(n-1) + F(n-2)。
给出若干个询问，每个询问一个 n，请输出 F(n) 除以 1000000007 的余数。

出处：《剑指 Offer（第 2 版）》剑指 Offer 10-I。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行一个整数 t（1 ≤ t ≤ 1000），表示询问个数。
第二行 t 个整数 n（0 ≤ n ≤ 100000）。
problem.output: t 行，第 i 行是第 i 个询问的答案。
hints: 直接按定义递归会重复计算同一项，时间是指数级的。从小到大递推，每项只算一次。
询问很多时，可以先把 0 到最大 n 的答案都算出来再查表。每一步都取模，避免数字过大。

en.title: Fibonacci Modulo a Prime
en.description:
The Fibonacci sequence is F(0) = 0, F(1) = 1 and F(n) = F(n-1) + F(n-2) for n ≥ 2.
For each query n, print F(n) modulo 1000000007.

Source: Coding Interviews (剑指 Offer, 2nd ed.), Offer 10-I. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 1000), the number of queries.
The second line holds t integers n (0 ≤ n ≤ 100000).
en.output: t lines; line i answers query i.
hints: Plain recursion recomputes the same terms and takes exponential time. Build the terms upward so each is computed once.
With many queries, compute every answer up to the largest n once and look them up. Reduce modulo at every step to keep numbers small.

problem.title: 扫地机器人能到达多少格
problem.description:
一块 m 行 n 列的地板，格子坐标从 (0, 0) 到 (m-1, n-1)。扫地机器人从 (0, 0) 出发，每次可以向上、下、左、右移动一格，不能离开地板。
有些格子被禁止进入：如果一个格子的行号各位数字之和加上列号各位数字之和大于 k，机器人就不能进入它。例如 k = 18 时，(35, 37) 可以进入，因为 3+5+3+7 = 18；(35, 38) 不能进入，因为 3+5+3+8 = 19。
请问机器人一共能到达多少个格子（包括起点）？

出处：《剑指 Offer（第 2 版）》剑指 Offer 13。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input: 一行三个整数 m、n、k（1 ≤ m, n ≤ 300，0 ≤ k ≤ 40）。
problem.output: 一个整数，机器人能到达的格子数。
problem.explanation:
样例 1 是 2 行 3 列、k = 1：(0, 0)、(0, 1)、(1, 0) 的数位和不超过 1，能到达，共 3 格。
样例 2 中 k = 0，机器人只能待在起点。
hints: 满足数位和条件的格子不一定都能到达：中间可能被禁止的格子隔开。要从起点做 BFS 或 DFS。
行号可能有三位数，数位和要把每一位都加上。

en.title: How Far the Robot Vacuum Goes
en.description:
A floor has m rows and n columns, cells (0, 0) to (m-1, n-1). A robot vacuum starts at (0, 0) and moves one cell up, down, left or right at a time without leaving the floor.
Some cells are off limits: the robot cannot enter a cell whose row digit sum plus column digit sum is greater than k. For k = 18, cell (35, 37) is allowed because 3+5+3+7 = 18, and (35, 38) is not because 3+5+3+8 = 19.
How many cells can the robot reach, the start included?

Source: Coding Interviews (剑指 Offer, 2nd ed.), Offer 13. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input: One line with three integers m, n and k (1 ≤ m, n ≤ 300, 0 ≤ k ≤ 40).
en.output: One integer: the number of reachable cells.
en.explanation:
Sample 1 is 2 rows by 3 columns with k = 1: (0, 0), (0, 1) and (1, 0) have digit sums at most 1 and are reachable, 3 cells in all.
In sample 2, k = 0 and the robot stays at the start.
hints: Not every allowed cell is reachable: blocked cells can cut a region off. Search from the start with BFS or DFS.
Row numbers can have three digits; add every digit.
